{{Short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |year = 2021–22 |team = Wake Forest Demon Deacons |sport = Basketball |image = Wake Forest University Athletic logo.svg |image_size = |conference = Atlantic Coast Conference |division = |short_conf = ACC |CoachRank = |APRank = |record = 25–10 |conf_record = 13–7 |head_coach = [[Steve Forbes (basketball)|Steve Forbes]] |hc_year = 2nd |asst_coach1 = [[BJ McKie]] |asst_coach2 = [[Jason Shay]] |asst_coach3 = [[Brooks Savage]] |stadium = [[Lawrence Joel Veterans Memorial Coliseum|LJVM Coliseum]] |champion = |tourney = [[2022 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] |tourney_result = Quarterfinals }} {{2021–22 ACC men's basketball standings}} The '''2021–22 Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball team''' represented [[Wake Forest University]] during the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Demon Deacons were led by second-year head coach [[Steve Forbes (basketball)|Steve Forbes]] and played their home games at the [[Lawrence Joel Veterans Memorial Coliseum]] in [[Winston-Salem, North Carolina]] as members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. The Demon Deacons finished the season 25–10 overall and 13–7 in [[2021–22 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]], to finish in fifth place. They lost to [[2021–22 Boston College Eagles men's basketball team|Boston College]] in the Second Round of the [[2022 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2022 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]], where they defeated [[2021–22 Towson Tigers men's basketball team|Towson]] and [[2021–22 VCU Rams men's basketball team|VCU]] in the first two rounds. Their season then ended in a quarterfinal loss to [[2021–22 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team|Texas A&M]]. ==Previous season== The [[2020–21 Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball team|Demon Deacons]] finished [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 6–16, 3–15 in [[2020–21 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]], to finish in fourteenth place. They lost to [[2020–21 Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball team|Notre Dame]] in the First Round of the [[2021 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]]. They were not invited to either the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] or [[2021 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {|
